description: This Java source file defines the SmsReceivedDialog class, an Android activity that handles the display and speech synthesis of received SMS messages. It presents a dialog with options to reply or dismiss, initializes TextToSpeech for auditory notification, and manages user interactions related to incoming SMS messages.

classes.name: SmsReceivedDialog
classes.description: An Android activity that receives SMS info via intent extras, displays it in a dialog, and uses TextToSpeech to audibly read the message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves SMS details from intent extras, constructs a message string, shows a dialog, and initializes TTS.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for TextToSpeech initialization; sets language and starts speaking the message if successful.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a dialog to display the received message with options to reply or dismiss.
